pages.about: Ashgrove Mercantile stocks durable goods for the desk, the bag and the everyday. We buy in small quantities from makers we have visited, and we keep items in the range only as long as they hold up to daily use.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery in unused condition with original packaging. Refunds issued within 5 business days of receipt. Faulty goods are replaced or refunded in full including postage both ways.
pages.shipping_policy: Standard shipping $6.00, free over $80, delivered in 3-5 business days. Express shipping $15.00, delivered in 1-2 business days. Orders placed before noon ship the same business day.
